instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React .js files and Lucide React icons (`lucide-react`).
All text in the merchant cabinet MUST be in Ukrainian as specified in the problem statement.

Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, table rows, modals, tabs) include unique `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='deposit-button'`, `data-testid='generate-token-btn'`).
Use standard `sonner` toasts for notifications (token copied, secret regenerated, invoice created).
Make sure header dropdowns and popovers have solid backgrounds (e.g., `bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800`), NEVER full transparent.

Replicate the OKIPAYS visual hierarchy: large rounded white cards (`rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100`), vivid action pill buttons, live price ticker chips, balance area chart, recent transactions status badges, and merchant API settings page.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain high visual distinction with generous internal container padding.
Ensure all charts (Recharts) use accessible, high-contrast brand colors.
Always test interactive states (hover, focus, active) with explicit text contrast classes.
Keep navigation and state fully functional with mock data and local state management.
